BOND BEYOND GUIDE

A reference for
raising, riding and
equipping creatures,
and forging Sea
Serpent Steel
underwater.

Choose a topic in
the contents.
Author: Gravtian.

Getting started

Version 0.2.2.
Sea Serpent care and
dragon equipment.
Minecraft 1.20.1,
Forge, Citadel,
Ice and Fire beta-5
and Tectonic 2.4.x.
Do not install CE
with original IAF.

Serpent eggs

Wild female drops:
Stage 3: 25%
Stage 4: 50%
Stage 5: 1 egg, 100%
No Ancient check.
At death, not corpse.
Rates: server config.
Hatched/owned: breed.
Males/Stage 1-2: none.
7 colors; Jade: sex.

Incubation

Ocean biome only.
Need 15 water blocks
above the egg. Ocean
temperature changes
hatching speed.
Pressure is safe to
20 water blocks above.
Deeper water can
break eggs; check
your server config.

Growth

Five growth stages.
Dragon Meal: +1 day.
Creative Meal: max.
Cap: 125 days,
scale 11.
While in warm ocean
water: 1.3x growth.
Tune ocean speeds in
the server config.
Growth lock wins.

Stop growth

Sickly Dragon Meal
permanently locks
growth. Time, Dragon
Meal and Creative
Dragon Meal can no
longer increase size.
The lock survives
saving and reloading.

Feeding / taming

Fish tame hatchlings;
retry if it fails.
Creative Dragon Meal
tames them instantly.
Fish restore hunger
and health. No
pufferfish. Full and
healthy: no food used.
Age, sex and stats:
serpent inventory.

Inventory

With both hands
empty, the owner
sneak-right-clicks to
open the serpent
inventory. The
equipment slot takes
Sea Serpent armor
with its built-in
saddle, not a normal
horse saddle.

Mount armor

Iron +9; silver/gold
+13; diamond +21;
netherite +29; steels
+41. Built-in saddle.
Plates: body, head,
tail and fin bases.
Fin webs keep color.
Sea Steel set: five
Sea Steel blocks +
one saddle.

Riding

Riding requires stage
3 or higher and
equipped mount armor.
Right-click with both
hands empty. Swim with
WASD, ascend with
Space and descend
with X. Keys can be
rebound in Controls.

Mounted combat

V: bite. Hold R:
water spray.
G: breach / slam.
F7: camera views.
Rear reticle aims
bite and breath.
Small bubbles spray
from the open mouth;
older: more + wider.
Client: camera/FX.

Breach / slam

Aim before pressing
G: the launch
direction is locked
when the move starts.
Underwater, the
serpent rises before
lunging/slamming. Wait
for its cooldown and
follow in-game
messages.

Dragon Staff

Wander/Stay/Follow
(Escort). Sneak:
set home. Wander
seeks water. Follow
faces the owner. All
three defend you on
land and in water;
your pets are safe.
Near bite; far spray.
Then resume command.

Owner protection

A tamed serpent's
bite, breath and slam
cannot damage its
owner. Stage 4
reduces pushes by
99%; stage 5 blocks
collision pushes. Wild
serpents use
equivalent size
thresholds.

Heart of the Sea

Heart of the Sea
raises a serpent's
maximum health up to
the IAF stage-5
dragon health cap.
Reach that cap to
unlock its breeding
requirement.

Breeding

Same owner, male +
female, both Stage 5
and Heart HP capped.
Both must be Wander,
unridden and nearby.
Use Heart of the Sea
after both cooldowns.
One heart = one egg.
Cooldown: 5 minutes.
Stay/Follow: no mate.

Dragon armor

Netherite armor fits
all three dragon
species in their head,
neck, body and tail
slots. Upgrade each
diamond piece with
one Netherite ingot
and an upgrade
template at a smithing
table.

Dragonsteel armor

Dragonsteel mount
armor uses native IAF
items with
species-correct
textures. These
pieces are crafted
with ingots instead of
storage blocks. Each
Netherite mount piece
adds seven armor.

Serpent remains

The body rolls, curls
and sinks to the floor.
Click neck/body/tail.
Items without a use
action: right-click.
Items with an ability
or use action:
Shift + right-click.
No hand swapping!

Collect blood

Right-click a fleshy
corpse with a glass
bottle. Pick up the
blood bottle it drops.
Blood shares the
flesh harvest budget:
each bottle replaces
one meat/scale
harvest. Skeletons
contain no blood.

Bones and skulls

Harvest in order:
scales/fillets, then
bones/fangs; the
last drop is a skull.
Loot drops into the
world. Higher stages
give more harvests.
Skulls keep real size.
Place; sneak to turn,
hit to pick back up.

Materials

Cook fillets in a
furnace, smoker or
campfire. Four bones
make a bone block
and can be unpacked
again. Native IAF
scale blocks remain
available in all seven
colors.

Sea Serpent bricks

Combine five
same-color scales
with four stone bricks
in a checkerboard to
get four Sea Serpent
bricks. Seven colors
exist. The forge uses
these bricks, not
scale blocks.

Forge supplies

Bring 17 matching
serpent bricks, eight
serpent bone blocks,
one core and one
input. Core: eight
bones around a Heart
of the Sea. Input:
four bones and four
fangs around a water
bucket.

Bottom / top

The forge is a 3x3x3
cube. Bottom and top
match: bone blocks at
the four corners;
bricks at the center
and four edge
centers. Each layer
uses four bone
blocks and five
bricks.

Middle layer

Middle layer: core in
the center and bricks
at all four corners.
Three edge centers
are bricks; the
remaining edge is the
input. Exactly one
input; every brick
must share a color.

Submerge the forge

The entire forge must
be underwater, with
water touching all
four outside faces
and covering the
roof. A solid seabed
is fine. Draining water
or mixing brick colors
stops forging.

Make Sea Steel

Click core / input
for the GUI. Bricks
open only a complete
submerged forge.
Iron above, blood
below; output right.
One iron + one blood
bottle produces one
Sea Steel ingot.

Power the forge

Tamed stage 3+,
unridden, in range.
Set Wander / Staying.
Keep input exposed.
It turns, holds still
and breathes while
the forge has work.
Escort cannot forge.
Or aim mounted R.

While forging

Each ingot needs
about ten seconds of
sustained breath.
Empty bottles return
beside the forge.
Progress cools
without breath; a
broken frame or
drained water resets
progress.

Sea Serpent Steel

Sea Steel: sword, axe,
pickaxe, shovel, hoe,
bow, arrows and four
armor pieces. Use
steel ingots and
serpent bone handles
in the usual tool
patterns.

Drowning weapons

Melee tools, the steel
bow and steel arrows
inflict six seconds of
drowning: 25%
slowness, periodic
drowning damage and
many splashes, even
on dry land.

Bow and arrows

The steel bow imbues
its arrows while
preserving ammo type
and enchantments.
Steel arrows work
with ordinary bows
too. One ingot, one
bone and one feather
craft four arrows.

Player armor

Sea Steel armor
blends Dragonsteel
plates and Tide
Guardian fins. Wear at
least one piece for
Water Breathing. While
wet, Strength scales
with the number of
equipped pieces.

Dragon Seeker

Normal Seeker
detects dragons
within 150 blocks,
including dead and
tamed ones. Epic
detects living
dragons within 200.
Legendary detects
living wild dragons
within 300.

Upgrade Seekers

Normal: a dragon skull
above two Netherite
ingots. Epic: smith it
with a Nether Star
and Netherite
template. Legendary:
skull above two
Dragonsteel ingots.
Seekers scan loaded
chunks only.

Godly Seeker

Godly is
Creative-only, scans
500 blocks for living
wild dragons and
shows coordinates.
Clicking them
suggests a teleport
command; normal
command permissions
still apply.

Sea Serpent Horn

4 bones + 1 fang;
see the recipe book.
Main-hand right-click
your unridden serpent
to store it. Click
water or a block top
to release with room.
Age/health/gear stay;
age pauses inside.
Blocked? Horn stays.

Bubble erosion

Dirt → gravel → sand.
Irregular patches.
One soil step / 2s.
Stage 5: max 20
soil changes / sec.
Other stages: fewer.
Forge bed shares the
same erosion budget.
Server config tunes
reach/cap and on/off.

Electrical arcs

Lightning tools from
IAF and addons use
arcs. First arc always
on a valid hit, even
a killing blow. Chains
reach 12 blocks from
impact, up to 10 foes;
half damage per hop.
Pets/allies are spared.

Elemental shields

Block a real hit:
Water: drowning 6s.
Fire: burning 5s.
Ice: freezing 5s.
Lightning: arcs.
Range: 10 blocks,
line of sight needed.
Cooldown: 0.5s.
Allies are spared.

Bones, blood, shields

Sword: 2 serpent
bones above a stick.
Add serpent blood:
6s drowning on hit.
Shield: 5 matching
steel ingots around
a shield and bone.
Durability: 2500.
Repair: same ingot.

Elemental matchups

Water: fire x1.6,
ice x1.5, shock x1.
Serpent takes: fire
x1, ice x1.3,
shock x1.6. Counter
armor removes bonus.
Wild/tame breath:
age-scaled damage;
stage 1-5 drowning
lasts 2/4/6/8/10s.

Counter armor

Matching the attack
element removes its
weakness bonus: x1.
Effects still apply.
Dragons need all four
matching pieces; a
serpent equips one
complete armor item.
Mixed sets do not.

Sea Steel for dragons

All three dragons
can wear Sea Steel.
Head, neck, body,
tail use the normal
dragonsteel patterns
with Sea Steel.
Full set removes the
water bonus, but not
Drowning. +10 / part.

Wild serpent age

Spawn size selects a
stage; a random day
in its range gives a
matching age/scale.
Growth then follows.
Reload never rerolls.
Corpse, skeleton and
skull keep death age,
stage and real size.
